data.overview: A young property agent travels to a remote mountain estate to complete a routine sale, only to find his host is a pale nobleman with an unnatural interest in his home town. As the count's shadow lengthens across the valley, the visitor discovers the bargain was made for far more than land.
data.tagline: From the mountains, darkness has found a door.
data.title: The Night Count
